ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in recent Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future and St. Paul business owner cases
questions: How did the perpetrators of these fraud schemes launder their money?
What banks or financial institutions were involved?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of how these fraud schemes were able to operate and how to prevent similar schemes in the future.
